content_html:
Traveling by train to Machu Picchu is one of the most memorable experiences in Peru. The journey passes through the Sacred Valley of the Incas, following the Urubamba River, with spectacular Andean scenery that makes the ride an essential part of the trip.

Currently, there are two authorized train companies operating this route, each offering different service types, comfort levels, and onboard experiences. In this guide, we explain which train to take to Machu Picchu so you can choose the best option based on your travel style.

Trains to Machu Picchu: Essential Information

Route: Cusco / Sacred Valley – Aguas Calientes (Machu Picchu Town)
⏱ Travel time: 1.5 to 4 hours (depending on departure station)
Main stations: San Pedro, Poroy, Ollantaytambo
Allowed luggage: Small backpack or carry-on

Tip: The most commonly used station is Ollantaytambo, located in the Sacred Valley.

Train Companies That Go to Machu Picchu

PeruRail

The best-known railway company with the widest variety of services.

Expedition
Budget-friendly and practical, ideal for straightforward travelers.

Vistadome
Panoramic windows, onboard snacks, and spectacular views.

Belmond Hiram Bingham
Luxury all-inclusive service featuring gourmet dining, live music, and exclusive attention.

Inca Rail

A modern company recognized for comfort and quality service.

Voyager
Comfortable and affordable, ideal for mid-range budgets.

360°
Large windows and panoramic roof for enhanced landscape views.

First Class
Premium service with gourmet meals and drinks included.

Best Time to Travel by Train to Machu Picchu

April – October (Dry Season)

Stable weather and clear skies
Lower risk of delays
Better views during the journey

Tip: Book in advance, as train tickets sell out quickly.

Rainy Season

November – March

Frequent rain, especially in January and February
Greener landscapes and fewer tourists
Flexible schedules and reliable operators are recommended

Which Train Should You Choose Based on Your Travel Style?

Budget travel: Expedition / Voyager
Scenery lovers: Vistadome / 360°
Comfortable trip: Vistadome / First Class
Luxury experience: Hiram Bingham / First Class
